subject: CHANGELOG Unreleased and CLI.md contain the init ignore rules
source:
uv run python -c 'from pathlib import Path
changelog = Path("CHANGELOG.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
cli = Path("docs/guide/CLI.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
unreleased = changelog.split("## [1.4.1]", 1)[0]
assert "## [Unreleased]" in unreleased
assert ".retornatus/index/" in unreleased
assert "*.pem" in unreleased
assert "!.env.example" in unreleased
assert "# retornatus-gitignore:begin" in cli
assert ".retornatus/keys/*.pub" in cli
print("changelog and CLI reference ok")'
